category.name: Form Fields
category.preferred_workflow: Use DocumentBuilder's InsertTextInput, InsertCheckBox, and InsertComboBox methods to add form fields, then access them through Document.Range.FormFields for reading or updating. Always bootstrap a fresh document or a known template, assign unique names to generate matching bookmarks, and validate field presence and values before saving.

strict_api_bans: Do not assume that form fields already exist in a document before accessing them.
Do not use StructuredDocumentTag or content-control APIs when the task targets legacy form fields.
Do not reference helper types that are not part of Aspose.Words, such as TextFormFieldType from non-existent namespaces.
canonical_patterns: Create form fields with DocumentBuilder.InsertTextInput, InsertCheckBox, and InsertComboBox, supplying all required parameters.
Retrieve and modify fields via Document.Range.FormFields, using Result for text fields, Checked for check boxes, and Result for combo boxes.
Assign a distinct name to each field; Aspose.Words automatically creates a bookmark with the same identifier.
nullable_warning_prevention: Check that a FormField retrieved from the collection is not null before dereferencing its properties.
Guard against missing values when parsing external data, such as JSON, by validating deserialization results.
Avoid implicit conversions that could produce CS8600, CS8602, or CS8604 warnings by using explicit casts or matching types.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Incorrect overload usage for Insert* methods
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1503, CS1501, CS7036, or CS1509 errors because arguments of the wrong type or count are supplied.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code calls InsertTextInput, InsertCheckBox, or InsertComboBox with parameters that do not match the documented signatures, such as passing a bool where TextFormFieldType is required or omitting the maxLength argument.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the exact overloads: InsertTextInput(string name, TextFormFieldType type, string format, string defaultText, int maxLength); InsertCheckBox(string name, bool isChecked, int size); InsertComboBox(string name, string[] items, int selectedIndex).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words API reference for each method and match parameter types and order precisely.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Missing required namespaces or referencing non-existent types
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation produces CS0103, CS0246, or CS0234 errors indicating that identifiers like TextFormFieldType, FormFieldCollection, or Aspose.Words.Building are unknown.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The source file lacks using directives for Aspose.Words.Fields and other necessary namespaces, or it references types that are not part of the installed Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add using Aspose.Words.Fields; and ensure the project references Aspose.Words 26.11.0, which defines TextFormFieldType, FormField, and related classes.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always include the required namespaces listed in the category metadata before writing code.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Mixing legacy form fields with content controls
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Examples combine StructuredDocumentTag with InsertTextInput or InsertCheckBox, leading to logical errors or unsupported API calls.
common_failure_patterns.cause: A misunderstanding of the distinction between legacy form fields and modern content controls causes inappropriate API usage.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Restrict the solution to legacy form-field APIs (DocumentBuilder.Insert* and Range.FormFields) unless the task explicitly demands content controls.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Follow the canonical pattern that separates legacy field handling from StructuredDocumentTag usage.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Insufficient validation of field existence and value changes
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Code saves the document without confirming that a form field was created or that its Result/Checked property was updated, potentially leaving the document in an incorrect state.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Missing null checks and post-assignment assertions after accessing FormFields.
common_failure_patterns.fix: After retrieving a field, verify it is not null, then compare the property value after assignment; throw an exception or log an error if the check fails.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Incorporate explicit existence checks and value verification steps as part of every example.

narrative.overview: The Form Fields category covers creation, manipulation, and inspection of legacy form fields in Word documents using Aspose.Words 26.11.0. Verified examples demonstrate inserting text inputs, check boxes, combo boxes, batch processing, JSON-driven updates, and document protection while adhering to the prescribed workflow.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding agent with concise guidance to generate correct, compile-time-safe C# snippets that create and manage Aspose.Words legacy form fields, validate their existence, and apply document protection without mixing unsupported APIs or content controls.
validation_priorities: Validate that each inserted form field exists in the FormFields collection, has the expected name, and that its Result or Checked property reflects the intended value before the document is saved.
maintenance_notes: Keep the example code aligned with the Aspose.Words 26.11.0 API surface; update signatures and namespace imports if a newer version is adopted.
